policy: Release readiness is computed from canonical evidence, package/version state, and final promotion gates. The immutable v0.5.0 tag is preserved as a failed publication attempt; v0.5.1 must pass its own exact-main verification, manual release-gate, require-ready check, and tagged-release asset verification before publication.

release_blockers.reason: The v0.5.1 hotfix candidate has not yet been promoted to main and re-verified on its exact final commit.
release_blockers.safe_next_action: Merge only after PR CI is green; then rerun exact-main verify, manual release-gate, and v0.5:readiness:require-ready before creating the v0.5.1 tag.

previous_failed_publication.reason: verify-install-assets.mjs imported pathToFileURL from node:path instead of node:url

nonblocking_open_evidence.claim_limit: Real-world workflow maturity remains collecting; v0.5 must not claim demonstrated general reliability.
Playwright has bounded evidence while Browser Use and Cognee remain open; provider lifecycle must not be called validated.
Deterministic install lifecycle matrices do not equal real clean-machine Hermes lifecycle evidence.
